=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:9-15 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The script pushes only the version tag and stable tag, so the major-version moving tag (e.g. v1) is never updated.
  WHY: This creates a functional mismatch with the workflows, which push version, stable, and major-version tags, leaving major-version consumers on stale releases.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:6-15 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The script fetches and tags from origin/main instead of the stable branch used by the workflows.
  WHY: If main and stable diverge, the manual script can move the release tags to a different commit than the workflow path, which can point stable at the wrong release.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:402-418 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The workflow changes are not covered by contract tests or assertions that verify the use of refs/tags/ refspecs in git push commands.
  WHY: A future regression back to bare refspecs could pass CI and only fail at release time with the original ambiguity error; severity is medium because this is a regression-risk gap, not an active runtime bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:13-14 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script pushes only the version tag and stable tag, so the major-version moving tag is not updated.
  WHY: Manual releases via the script leave refs/tags/v1-style pointers stale while the workflows update them; this is pre-existing and not introduced by the PR.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:9-10 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script fetches and tags from origin/main instead of the stable branch used by the workflows.
  WHY: If main and stable diverge, the script can move the stable tag back to main’s HEAD; this is pre-existing behavior and not introduced by the PR.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

(No findings reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:12-14 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The script does not push the major-version moving tag (e.g., v1) that the workflows push, creating functional inconsistency.
  WHY: When using the manual script, the major-version floating tag is never created or updated, so consumers pinned to that major version get stale releases.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:11 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The script tags from origin/main rather than the stable branch used by workflows.
  WHY: If stable and main have diverged, the manual script will tag the wrong commit and move the stable pointer to a commit not on the stable branch.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml and test-and-mark-stable.yml:402-418 (mark-stable.yml), 3913-3927 (test-and-mark-stable.yml) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflows lack CI assertions or tests that verify the refs/tags/ refspec format is used.
  WHY: A future change could revert to bare refspecs and CI would still pass, only failing later when the ambiguity error recurs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:10-11 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The script tags the version from origin/main rather than from the checked-out stable branch.
  WHY: When origin/main is ahead of or behind stable, the manually-created version tag points to a different commit than the workflow-created one, and the stable pointer can move to the wrong commit.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:9-15 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow pushes three tags (version, stable, major), but the script pushes only two (version, stable).
  WHY: After a manual run, the major-version moving pointer is left stale, so consumers pinned to the major version receive an older release.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:9-15 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Script pushes only version tag and stable tag, omitting the major-version moving tag (e.g., v1) that workflows push.
  WHY: Manual releases via script leave major-version pointers stale and desynchronized from workflow releases, breaking consumer expectations that all three tags update identically.
- scripts/mark-stable.sh:6-8 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Script fetches and tags from origin/main instead of the checked-out stable branch used by workflows.
  WHY: Manual runs tag releases from main, which can diverge from the workflow path that releases from stable, and can move stable to the wrong commit.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:402-418 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: No contract tests or assertions verify refs/tags/ refspecs are used correctly in git push commands.
  WHY: A future regression to bare refspecs could pass static checks but recreate the push ambiguity error at release time.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
